policy_title: Tackle Special Educational Needs Provision Crisis
stated: Tackle the crisis in special educational needs provision, and help to end the postcode lottery in provision, by: Giving local authorities extra funding to reduce the amount that schools pay towards the cost of a child’s Education, Health and Care Plan. Establishing a new National Body for SEND to fund support for children with very high needs.

bearing_set.reason: Directly targets SEND provision funding and access, affecting educational opportunity and attainment for children with special educational needs.

membership_note: This is a single-target policy whose mechanism (LA grant funding + new national institution) operates entirely through educational provision and access. The 'postcode lottery' and equal-treatment dimension for disabled children is real but flows through O7's indicators (attainment gap, access, school funding adequacy) rather than through anti-discrimination law or rights enforcement (O9). No non-negligible cross-outcome harm can be mechanistically pinned: the policy pledges extra funding rather than cuts, so no specific O12 indicator movement can be established from the stated text alone.
